summary: CarMax Auto Funding LLC, as depositor, and CarMax Business Services, as sponsor, filed an 8-K reporting an Underwriting Agreement dated September 22, 2026 with J.P. Morgan Securities LLC, as representative of the underwriters, for $600,000,000 aggregate principal balance of asset-backed notes issued by CarMax Select Receivables Trust 2026-C. The deal comprises Class A-1 ($99.4M), A-2 ($203.4M), A-3 ($153.38M) and A-4 ($32.47M) notes, registered on Form SF-3, with an anticipated September 28, 2026 issuance date. This is a routine auto-loan ABS securitization, not a special situation; no equity stake, premium, or board recommendation is involved.
